services.service_name: Website Design: Websites that win customers (/services/website-design)
services.problem_resolved: No website or a slow one, so there is no online presence and nearby customers cannot find you; visitors leave without calling or booking, so a site that is not converting needs a clear next step on every page.
services.target_audience: New or very small businesses, and businesses whose site is not converting visitors into calls and bookings

services.service_name: App Development: Booking systems and customer portals (/services/app-development)
services.problem_resolved: Repetitive tasks done by hand, the same questions answered again and again, and customers who must call to find a time instead of booking online.
services.target_audience: Small businesses with a process to automate

services.problem_resolved: No mobile access for customers or staff, and no way for customers to interact with the business or check their status from a phone.
services.target_audience: Businesses whose customers or team need an app on their phone

services.service_name: Local SEO: Get found on Google (/services/local-seo)
services.problem_resolved: Poor visibility on Google: your business is not found online by nearby customers, your Google Business Profile is unclaimed or incomplete, and few customers leave reviews.
services.target_audience: Local businesses that want nearby customers to find them first

services.service_name: Social Media Marketing: Done for you (/services/social-media-marketing)
services.problem_resolved: Social media keeps falling to the bottom of your list, so customer engagement is low and you rarely post; we plan, post and report monthly, and you always own your accounts.
services.target_audience: Business owners with no time to post consistently

services.service_name: Paid Ads: Track every ad dollar (/services/paid-ads)
services.problem_resolved: Ad money spent with no way to see which ads generate leads, because calls and forms are not tracked.
services.target_audience: Established small businesses already advertising, or ready to start on Google and Meta
